structured.answer: I'd open an account at Psagot and buy the "ילין לפידות מחקה S&P 500 (4D)" fund, the one the page marks "הזול". With 10,000 now and 500 a month for 10 years, the page says about 86,492 ₪. Those are the page's example amounts, not my 30,000.

stuck.why: I deposit 70,000 and after 10 years at 7% I'm left with only 86,492. That's far below the roughly 70% more I'd expect, and I didn't get why ('בכסף של היום'?)
The example is 10,000 + 500 a month, not my 30,000. I couldn't change it to my amount, so I'm left without my own number
'מה החשבון גובה ב־10 שנים: 1,057 ₪'. Not sure what it is. Shekels, so it sounds like a real cost
Lots of funds and colourful tags I don't understand, so I only went by the minus numbers on the left
The hedging part and the charts by year. I got bored and stopped there
